name: @stride/coach-agent-worker
description: Standalone TS worker for training plan jobs (Plan Job): consumes its own queue, runs the plan kernels with streaming progress, inserts plan drafts via the Go internal API.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run tsc
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/job/*.test.js dist/tests/storage/*.test.js dist/tests/queue/*.test.js dist/tests/kernel/*.test.js dist/tests/goClient/*.test.js dist/tests/data/*.test.js
